actions.message: Great job contributing heavily! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Average contribution is below 30%, so per Conditional Cooperation increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet, resulting in contributing the entire remaining wallet (5.47). No broadcast needed this round, and punishment is unaffordable. Praise a high contributor via private message.
